sloka: योजनानाम् सहस्राणि दश तानि दिवाकरः ।मुहूर्त अर्धेन तम् शीघ्रम् अभियाति शिल उच्चयम् ॥४-४२-४३॥
transliteration: yojanānām sahasrāṇi daśa tāni divākaraḥ ।muhūrta ardhena tam śīghram abhiyāti śila uccayam ॥4-42-43॥

translations.english: 'Crossing ten thousand yojanas swiftly in half a moment, the Sun touches the mount behind which he sets.
